courses.title: CFO Office
courses.subtitle: A cross-cutting overlay for CFOs, aspiring CFOs, controllership, treasury, and finance-transformation stakeholders who need value, risk, control, evidence, and next-decision framing in one place.

demos.title: AI ROI Calculator
demos.summary: Test whether an AI initiative has a credible finance case once implementation cost, capacity release, adoption curve, confidence range, and payback are made explicit. This is a CFO-facing value screen, not a hype screen.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which assumption moves the decision most: adoption, controls cost, or benefit confidence. The point is to make fragility visible before approval.

demos.title: AI Governance Scorecard
demos.summary: Pressure-test whether source traceability, approval rights, segregation of duties, human review, audit evidence, and judgement boundaries are strong enough for deployment.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push beyond generic governance and ask what a controller would need before accepting the workflow in a live finance setting.

demos.title: AI Decision Tracker
demos.summary: Capture a finance decision record with initiative owner, sponsor, process owner, data owner, evidence, risk, approval path, and review date so governance does not disappear after the meeting.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask who owns the decision six months later when the metric drifts. The answer should be explicit in the record, not implied.

demos.title: AI Workflow Demo
demos.summary: Design AP exception routing, close-status escalation, commentary review, or forecast-assumption challenge workflows without weakening controls or losing owner accountability.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which step can be automated safely and which step only looks repetitive but actually contains judgement.

demos.title: AI Content Summarizer
demos.summary: Review management-pack drafts with source evidence, unsupported-claim detection, and mandatory reviewer sign-off before finance narrative is released.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what would make the narrative unfit for CFO release even if the wording sounds plausible.

demos.title: Lite Parse Demo
demos.summary: Extract clauses from fictional contracts and invoices while keeping a visible boundary between information extraction and accounting judgement.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which clause can be extracted mechanically and which conclusion still needs finance or legal interpretation.

demos.title: Month-End Close Command Center
demos.summary: Decide whether close can proceed, which exceptions are material, what evidence is missing, and why the no-autonomous-posting rule matters in finance operations.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask whether the issue is speed, evidence, materiality, or ownership. CFO-facing close decisions usually combine all four.

demos.title: Finance Evidence and Data-Lineage Challenge
demos.summary: Trace generated commentary back to source rows and decide whether the output is fit for finance release or still contains unsupported statements.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: This is a great moment to contrast impressive output with defensible output. Finance only gets credit for the second one.

demos.title: Digital Finance Portfolio Simulator
demos.summary: Sequence finance initiatives using value, readiness, dependencies, people resistance, control risk, and investment capacity instead of selecting projects one by one.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what should go in wave one even if it is not the flashiest initiative. Portfolio discipline beats demo glamour.

demos.title: Finance Signal Triage
demos.summary: Corroborate soft signals with finance metrics before escalation so sentiment, anecdote, and market noise do not masquerade as finance evidence.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which combinations truly deserve escalation and which should remain monitored but not yet amplified.

demos.title: Payment Operations and Reconciliation Workbench
demos.summary: Classify mismatches, fee differences, chargebacks, and unresolved exceptions using materiality, ageing, owner, SLA, and escalation outcome rather than just raw queue volume.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which exception is operational noise and which one is becoming a control or stakeholder issue.

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Reveal how receivables actually flow through credit holds, disputes, short payments, and control exceptions before anyone decides that automation is the answer.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what should be eliminated upstream, what can be routed, and what still requires human judgement and monitoring.

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Reveal how AP work actually flows through missing PO, missing GRN, duplicate review, approval delays, and control exceptions before workflow tooling is chosen.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which queue is a policy or discipline issue upstream and which part of the stable path is finally ready for workflow enablement.

demos.title: Invoice-Level Collections Prediction
demos.summary: Compare contractual due dates with likely payment behavior so collections, cash forecasting, and human review are grounded in evidence rather than aging alone.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask how much trust the CFO should place in the model output before it affects funding, collection actions, or external commitments.

demos.title: Treasury Control Tower
demos.summary: Frame the current treasury operating picture across liquidity, controls, alerts, and action choices so CFO-level decisions have an operating context before deeper analysis begins.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what the top three actions are if the dashboard is directionally right but still incomplete. CFOs act under partial visibility all the time.

courses.title: Digital Payments
courses.audience: payment rails, UPI, cards, reconciliation, CBDC, wallet operations
courses.subtitle: Payment rails, UPI states, card economics, settlement and reversals, operations and reconciliation, wallets, CBDC, and programmable money trade-offs.

demos.title: Payment Journey and Rail Simulator
demos.summary: Choose UPI, cards, wallets, NEFT, RTGS, cash, or Bitcoin and watch the message flow, participants, clearing and settlement path, time to finality, fees, liquidity implications, and failure handling change in real time. This is the course’s anchor system-map demo.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "At which step does the customer think the payment is done, and at which step is the institution actually safe?" This separates experience from operational finality.

demos.title: UPI Transaction and Failure Simulator
demos.summary: Simulate payer PSP, payee PSP, NPCI switch, remitter bank, and beneficiary bank across push and collect flows. Compare timeouts, duplicates, reversals, fraud checks, limits, and reconciliation exceptions without hiding the operational state machine.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why is ‘pending’ often the most dangerous state in instant payments?" This reveals where customer, fraud, and reconciliation pain collide.

demos.title: Card Network Economics and Settlement Simulator
demos.summary: Follow the cardholder → merchant → acquirer → network → issuer chain and see how interchange, MDR, gateway costs, fraud loss, refunds, chargebacks, and settlement delay determine merchant margin and issuer economics.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on unit economics: "If gross sales rise but chargebacks and fees rise faster, did the merchant really win?"

demos.title: Payment Operations and Reconciliation Workbench
demos.summary: Work through bank, gateway, network, and merchant records with deliberate mismatches. Classify missing transactions, duplicates, fee discrepancies, pending reversals, chargeback timing, and settlement-date differences.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which exception actually changes money owed, and which one only changes timing or reporting?" This teaches operational materiality.

demos.title: CBDC Design Studio
demos.summary: Configure retail vs wholesale, token vs account, direct vs hybrid, privacy, offline support, holding limits, interest, and programmability. See how these design choices reallocate resilience, policy control, inclusion, and bank-disintermediation risk.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which CBDC choice solves one policy problem by creating another operational problem?" That keeps the discussion grounded.

demos.title: Fraud Playground
demos.summary: Use this as the course’s fraud-threshold companion lab when discussing false positives, operational loss, and customer friction in payment monitoring.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask students which fraud threshold they would choose if support costs and abandonment are as important as raw fraud loss.

demos.title: Credit Card Transaction Fraud
demos.summary: Local Python fraud-classification workflow for card transactions. Use it when you want students to move from a browser fraud intuition to a fuller feature-engineering and classification pipeline.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which transaction features would travel well to real card auth data, and which are only classroom placeholders?"

demos.title: Mule Account Detection
demos.summary: Support the course’s AML and account-abuse discussions with a demo that connects suspicious flow patterns to intervention timing and false-positive burden.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask students whether faster intervention always helps, or whether it can also freeze legitimate customer activity and increase complaint load.

demos.title: Pricing and Unit Economics Explorer
demos.summary: Use this adjacent demo to reinforce fee design, platform economics, and business-model trade-offs when comparing payment products and merchant pricing.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what changes if the product owner optimizes growth, margin, and trust in a different order.

demos.title: Threat Modeling Matrix
demos.summary: Use this to surface security-by-design questions in payment apps, PSP integrations, beneficiary management, and mobile payment journeys.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which payment-step threat deserves prevention first and which one deserves rapid detection plus recovery instead.

demos.title: Blockchain Explorer
demos.summary: Use this as the bridge from mainstream payment rails into crypto settlement, token movement, and the infrastructure intuition needed for stablecoins and CBDC debates.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask students which parts of blockchain settlement are actually useful for payments and which parts are just implementation detail.

demos.title: Smart Contract Treasury
demos.summary: Bring this in when the class moves from payment execution to conditional money movement, escrow logic, and programmable release conditions.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push students to compare smart-contract logic with ordinary API-based workflow controls rather than assuming the chain is always necessary.

demos.title: Supply Chain Finance
demos.summary: Use this when discussing business-payment ecosystems, supplier settlement timing, and embedded-finance extensions around invoice and platform flows.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask where the payment ends and the financing product begins, and why that boundary matters operationally.

courses.title: Treasury Management
courses.subtitle: Liquidity, working capital, FX hedging, cash conversion cycle, digital treasury, and AI-enabled treasury transformation for CFO aspirants.

demos.title: AI Hedge Orchestrator
demos.summary: Your multinational has €50M in revenue exposure to EUR/USD volatility. AI recommends a hedge—but at what ratio and cost? Decide between full/partial hedges and learn why underhedging can destroy shareholder value faster than overhedging.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Emphasize the tradeoff: cheaper partial hedges leave you exposed. Why would a CFO accept residual risk? When do you fully hedge vs. layer hedges over time?

demos.title: Treasury Analytics Notebook Hub
demos.summary: Move from spreadsheets to analytics. Walk through a multi-week treasury forecasting workflow: data prep → anomaly detection → cash flow forecasting → dashboard insights. Learn how to catch forecast drift before it hits operations and how to automate weekly reporting that treasury teams can act on.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on this: "Your forecast was right 20 times but wrong 2 times catastrophically. Why trust it?" This reveals the gap between statistical accuracy and operational reliability—data quality matters more than model complexity.

demos.title: Invoice-Level Collections Prediction
demos.summary: Not all late invoices are the same. One customer is 60 days late but historically pays; another is 45 days late but never has. AI ranks payment risk by customer patterns, dispute likelihood, and relationship tenure—not just days outstanding. See how predictive signals beat static aging rules and recover $$ faster.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Would you pursue a 120-day-late $50K invoice from a tier-1 customer who always pays eventually?" This reveals strategic collections—sometimes patience pays more than pressure.

demos.title: AR Aging & Collections Prioritizer
demos.summary: Your AR team has $10M outstanding across 500 customers. Age alone doesn't tell the story. Risk-score by customer health, payment history, and relationship tenure to focus collections effort where it matters. See how intelligent segmentation recovers more cash faster than "call everyone 60 days late."
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Change the risk weights and watch accounts reorder. Ask: "Is the new priority order better because of genuine risk, or because of invoice size?" This teaches the difference between statistically sound prioritization and intuitive judgment.

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Most finance teams can describe the designed order-to-cash flow, but cash gets delayed by the path that work actually takes. Start from a clean happy path, then reveal credit holds, delivery disputes, short payments, unapplied cash, and a control breach from a fictional event log. Use the output to decide what to eliminate, standardize, enable, retain as human judgement, and monitor.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which O2C delay is a workflow problem, which is an upstream discipline problem, and which must remain controlled?" This helps students separate process redesign from automation enthusiasm.

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Notebook
demos.summary: Use the Colab companion when you want students to inspect how variant counts, lead time, wait time, rework, first-pass yield, straight-through processing, and control exceptions are calculated from the event log. It uses the same fictional Asteron O2C data as the browser workbench and includes step-by-step explanations after each code block.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on the assumptions behind touch time and exception rules. The teaching value here is not the code itself; it is the transparency of the logic behind the finance conclusion.

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Most teams can describe the designed invoice-to-payment-ready flow, but supplier delay and AP friction are driven by the path work actually takes. Start from a clean AP happy path, then reveal missing PO, missing GRN, duplicate review, approval delays, and a control breach from a fictional event log. Use the output to decide what to eliminate, standardize, enable, retain as human judgement, and monitor.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which AP delay is a workflow problem, which is an upstream discipline problem, and which must remain controlled?" This helps students separate process redesign from automation enthusiasm.

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Notebook
demos.summary: Use the Colab companion when you want students to inspect how variant counts, lead time, wait time, rework, first-pass yield, straight-through processing, and control exceptions are calculated from the AP event log. It uses the same fictional Asteron P2P data as the browser workbench and includes step-by-step explanations after each code block.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on the assumptions behind touch time and exception rules. The teaching value here is not the code itself; it is the transparency of the logic behind the finance conclusion.

demos.title: Interest Rate Risk
demos.summary: About Demo learning guide for Interest Rate Risk: a browser launch surface with Colab and local notebook support for deposit repricing and shock analysis.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for deposit mix, rate shock, post-shock cost, and repricing concentration.

demos.title: Liquidity Management
demos.summary: About Demo learning guide for Liquidity Management: a Colab and local notebook launch guide for liquidity stress testing and Monte Carlo analysis.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for inflow and outflow stress, liquidity gap, Monte Carlo range, and action threshold.

demos.title: Mesa Liquidity Data Generator
demos.summary: Build a bank's balance sheet: customer deposits, savings rates, withdrawal patterns. Then stress it: what if 10%, 20%, 30% of customers withdraw simultaneously? Monte Carlo shows the range of liquidity outcomes. Learn how asset-liability managers size funding buffers and when to tap contingency facilities.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Emphasize the behavioral assumption: "You're assuming customers behave historically. But what if crisis sentiment changes behavior?" This connects data science to operational reality—models assume conditions stay stable when stress breaks that assumption.

demos.title: CCC Analyzer
demos.summary: You collect from customers in 45 days but must pay suppliers in 30 days. That 15-day gap ties up working capital. See how DSO, DIO, and DPO interact—and why a 10-day improvement in receivables can unlock millions in cash without borrowing.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on this: "If you improve collections by 10 days, how much cash is freed up?" Then show the compounding effect across the quarter. Make it real with balance sheet impact.

demos.title: Dell vs Competitors Working Capital Case
demos.summary: Why does Dell unlock billions in cash faster than HP? Compare receivables, inventory, and payables cycles across the PC industry. See how Dell's direct-to-consumer model compressed CCC from 60 days to negative days—generating free cash while competitors waited. Understand business model impact on treasury.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Can Apple or HP replicate Dell's CCC?" The answer is no—because CCC isn't just a metric, it's a reflection of business model, customer mix, and operational excellence. Treasury is strategy.

demos.title: Collections Predictor
demos.summary: You have 200 invoices overdue. Who pays first? AI ranks by risk, but should you chase the $500K account that's 60 days late or the $50K account that's 120 days late? Learn how payment pattern history beats invoice size in predicting cash recovery.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why doesn't the biggest invoice always come first?" This reveals the power of behavioral signals—historical payment discipline trumps transaction size in risk assessment.

demos.title: FX Hedge Simulator
demos.summary: You sell ¥1 billion annually. USD strengthens and your revenue drops €2M. Did you hedge too little, or was the cost of hedging worse? Learn why CFOs are paid to make hedging decisions under uncertainty—perfect foresight doesn't exist in real markets.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Show both scenarios: "What if you'd fully hedged at a 2% premium? What if you'd hedged nothing?" This drives home that hedging trades downside insurance for opportunity cost.

demos.title: Smart Contract Treasury
demos.summary: Code becomes law on-chain. Define treasury rules in a smart contract—e.g., "approve wire transfers only if balance > $5M AND approval is dual-signature." No CFO override, no exceptions. Is this efficient or a risk? Learn when to automate treasury vs. when human judgment matters.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Prompt: "If a smart contract rules fail, who's liable? Can you override it?" This reveals the tension between decentralized governance and operational reality. Rules are immutable—but should treasury ever be?

demos.title: Stablecoin Manager
demos.summary: You issue a stablecoin pegged at $1. Suddenly, $100M in redemptions arrive—everyone wants their USD back. You have enough reserves, but peg pressure forces a choice: raise interest rates to attract new deposits, or hold steady and watch the peg crack? Learn collateral management and reserve mechanics of decentralized stablecoins.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: This is modern monetary policy in real-time. Ask: "How is this different from managing a bank run?" Stablecoins are a treasury function for issuers—liability management under duress.

demos.title: Treasury Control Tower
demos.summary: It's Friday 5 PM. Your cash position is $2M but you're expecting a $10M outflow Monday. The AI forecasts a gap. Do you draw a credit line today (cost: facility fee), defer payments, or trust the forecast to adjust? See how AI-powered liquidity monitoring drives real-time treasury decisions.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge the forecast: "How confident is this AI model? What happens if it's wrong?" This teaches false confidence—AI is a tool for speed, not certainty. CFOs still own the decision.

demos.title: Treasury Transform Blueprint
demos.summary: Your CFO says "we need to modernize treasury." Where do you start? Dashboard? Automation? API integration? Design a multi-year roadmap that prioritizes quick wins (free up cash now) while building toward future state (real-time insights, autonomous execution). Learn how transformation value compounds across initiatives.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge sequencing: "Why would you build a dashboard before fixing data quality?" This reveals how treasury transformation requires sequencing—you can't automate garbage data.

courses.title: AI/ML Workflows
courses.subtitle: Hands-on AI product, model, workflow, governance, and decision-support demos for finance and business learners.

demos.title: AB Testing Framework
demos.summary: Your team claims a new feature increases engagement. But did it, or did randomness fool you? Design AB tests with proper controls, sample sizes, and significance thresholds. Learn why most "winning" features are false positives without rigorous experimental design.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "How many users do you need to see a real effect? What's the cost of a false positive vs. a false negative?" This reveals statistical rigor and business trade-offs.

demos.title: AI Cost Benefit Analyzer
demos.summary: Your CFO asks: "Why invest $2M in AI when we don't know the payoff?" Build a business case by modeling infrastructure costs, labor savings, revenue uplift, and risk. See how hidden assumptions (adoption rates, productivity gains) drive ROI—and how small changes swing the decision.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge the assumptions: "What if adoption is 40% instead of 80%? What if labor savings never materialize?" This teaches sensitivity analysis and the power of assumptions in business decisions.

demos.title: AI Data Analyzer
demos.summary: Your dataset has 500K rows but 30% missing values. How do you proceed? Explore distributions, anomalies, and data quality. Learn the truth: garbage data in = garbage model out. Data literacy comes before modeling
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Would you build a model on this dataset? Why or why not?" This teaches healthy skepticism and the reality that data prep is 80% of the work

demos.title: AI Decision Tracker
demos.summary: Every AI-assisted decision should have evidence. Document what you decided, why, and what changed your mind. Trace decisions over time to see which assumptions were right and which broke. Build accountability into workflows, not just dashboards.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "In 6 months, could you explain why you made this decision? What evidence supported it?" This teaches decision hygiene and the power of records.

demos.title: AI Feature Impact
demos.summary: Model says "age is your most important feature" for loan approval. But is age causally predictive, or just correlated with something else? Learn why feature importance can mislead—correlation ≠ causation in machine learning.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge this: "Why does age matter? Is it causal or a proxy for credit history? What would you do about it?" This reveals why explainability matters beyond accuracy.

demos.title: AI PRD Template
demos.summary: Great PRDs start with the problem, not the algorithm. Define success metrics, failure modes, and human oversight checkpoints BEFORE you code. See how product thinking (not just ML thinking) drives adoption and adoption drives value.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "What's the actual user problem? How do you know when you've solved it?" This forces clarity before building.

demos.title: AI Performance Dashboard
demos.summary: Your model was 95% accurate yesterday. Today 87%. What happened? Monitor for drift, data decay, and concept shift in production. ML is not "train and deploy"—it's continuous monitoring, retraining, and governance.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "What changed? Customer behavior? Data quality? Competition? How would you know?" This teaches production thinking.

demos.title: AI Product Canvas
demos.summary: Who uses this AI? What job are they doing? What data exists? Map user need → AI capability → data source → value metric on a one-page canvas. Stress-test whether an AI project is worth building before you invest.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge: "If you can't fill this canvas clearly, the project isn't ready. What's missing?" This forces clarity on product-market fit.

demos.title: AI ROI Calculator
demos.summary: Calculate payback period, NPV, IRR for AI initiatives. But don't forget: compare against hiring, outsourcing, and rule-based systems. "AI is cheaper" is often wrong—context and adoption rates matter more than the algorithm.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge: "What's your true cost of ownership? Include maintenance, retraining, and updates over 3 years." This prevents hidden costs from destroying ROI.

demos.title: AI Resource Planner
demos.summary: Building an AI team requires data scientists, engineers, PMs, and ops. Forecast capacity when multiple projects compete for limited talent. Learn the hard truth: hiring is the constraint, not compute or algorithms.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Where's your bottleneck? Usually it's people, not technology. What's your hiring plan?" This teaches team scaling reality.

demos.title: AI Team Collaboration
demos.summary: Data scientist builds a model; engineer can't deploy it. Dependencies matter. Track who owns what, blockers, and cross-functional communication. Learn: technical skill ≠ shipping ability. Collaboration is the constraint.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why do some teams ship fast and others stall? Usually it's friction between functions, not technical difficulty." This teaches organizational realities.

demos.title: AI Workflow
demos.summary: Your AI confidence is only 75%—don't fully automate. Design workflows with human checkpoints. Where does a human review before action? Automation with oversight beats blind automation. Learn governance inside workflows.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge: "If your AI makes a $10M decision, do you really not want human review?" This teaches the governance question that matters.

demos.title: Bank Failure Prediction
demos.summary: Regulators need early warning of failing banks. Build a model. But if you flag a healthy bank, you cause panic. False positives and false negatives have asymmetric costs. Learn: metrics alone don't tell the full story.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "What's worse: missing a failing bank or falsely flagging a healthy one?" This reveals how business context shapes model thresholds.

demos.title: Copilot Kit
demos.summary: Your copilot is trained on company docs. Is it accurate or hallucinating? Explore prompt engineering, retrieval grounding, confidence scoring. Learn: "more training data" isn't always the answer—grounding and feedback loops are.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "How do you know when the copilot is making things up? What's your verification process?" This teaches grounding as a non-negotiable requirement.

demos.title: AI Page Agent
demos.summary: An agent browses the web and takes actions autonomously: fills forms, clicks buttons, navigates. How do you verify it understood the page correctly? Challenge of autonomous agents in messy, unstructured environments. When does autonomous beat human?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "How would you know if the agent made a mistake? What's your verification workflow?" This teaches autonomous systems must be verifiable.

demos.title: Data Drift Detector
demos.summary: Model trained 2022; still works 2025? Explore concept drift. Customer behavior changed, competition shifted. When do you retrain?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the reference distribution, current distribution, and drift signal.

demos.title: Emotional Support Assistant
demos.summary: Chatbot listens, responds with empathy. But can it recognize crisis? When must it escalate to human?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for user intent, sentiment cues, safety boundaries, and referral language.

demos.title: Feature Store
demos.summary: 100 models, each needs features. Centralize them—governance, reproducibility, speed. Avoid reimplementing the same feature.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for feature definitions, ownership, freshness, and reuse across models.

demos.title: ML Model Registry
demos.summary: Track 100 model versions. Which is production? Which performed best? Who trained it and when?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for model version, dataset version, metrics, owner, and approval status.

demos.title: Model Version Comparator
demos.summary: V2 has 92% accuracy, V1 had 89%. But V2 is slower. Trade-offs matter—accuracy vs. latency vs. cost.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the baseline model, challenger model, metric comparison, and segment results.

demos.title: Monte Carlo Company Valuation
demos.summary: Interactive browser-based Monte Carlo simulation for company valuation, five-year free cash flow, NPV, probability of value creation, and statistical confidence intervals.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the acquisition price, five-year free-cash-flow path, terminal value, WACC, and NPV distribution.

demos.title: Probabilistic Decision Engine
demos.summary: Not binary decisions—probability scores. Approve if confidence > 75%. Learn confidence intervals, decision thresholds, ROI curves.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for probability estimates, decision thresholds, and expected value calculations.

demos.title: Browser AI Demos — Edge AI Showcase
demos.summary: Run models in the browser, no server needed. See latency, accuracy, privacy trade-offs. When is edge AI better than cloud?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the range of local AI capabilities and the user problem each mini-demo solves.

demos.title: Local Chat Advisor
demos.summary: Chat runs locally, no data leaves device. Slower, smaller models. But privacy guaranteed. Trade-offs of local vs cloud AI.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the prompt, local response, and any limitations shown by the chat behavior.

demos.title: Smart Ticket Tagger
demos.summary: Customer support tickets flood in. Route by urgency, category, language. AI saves 40% manual triage time—but needs human oversight.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the support ticket text, predicted category, and confidence level.

demos.title: Privacy Notebook
demos.summary: Analyze data privately. Differential privacy adds noise—protects individuals but costs accuracy. Find the sweet spot.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for sensitive data types, redaction behavior, and privacy risk signals.

demos.title: Whisper Transcriber
demos.summary: Convert speech to text. Works on accents, background noise. Understand accuracy, latency, computational cost.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for audio input, transcription output, and timing or speaker cues.

demos.title: Named Entity Tagger
demos.summary: Extract entities: names, dates, locations from text. See how context matters. "Apple" is company or fruit?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for named entities, categories, and context around each extraction.

demos.title: Semantic Search
demos.summary: Search by meaning, not keywords. "How do I fix my laptop?" finds articles about troubleshooting, not just "laptop."
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the query, retrieved documents, and relevance ranking.

demos.title: Opinion Quintuple Extractor
demos.summary: Extract sentiment, target, aspect, reason from reviews. "This phone's camera is great but battery drains fast."
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for opinion holder, target, sentiment, aspect, and explanation.

demos.title: SYNAPSE — Semantic Word Game
demos.summary: Game tests your knowledge of semantic relationships. Explore word embeddings—how AI understands meaning.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for word relationships, hints, and the path students use to reason semantically.

demos.title: PM Product Demos
demos.summary: Product management playbook: launch roadmap, feature prioritization, metrics. Build AI products, not just models.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the product decision, evidence, stakeholder, and recommended next step.

demos.title: Experimentation & Metrics Simulator
demos.summary: Design experiments. Define success metrics. Run A/B tests. Learn p-values, sample size, statistical significance.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the experiment goal, primary metric, guardrail metric, and sample size.

courses.title: Banking & Finance

demos.title: Loan Default Predictor
demos.summary: You approve 90% of loan applications, but 8% default. Tighten lending and reduce defaults to 5%, but approval rate drops to 70%. Which trade-off is better for profitability? Learn how default prediction shapes portfolio composition, capital allocation, and bank risk-taking appetite.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge the threshold: "Why not deny everyone? You'd have zero defaults." This reveals the core lending paradox: higher accuracy ≠ higher profits. Portfolio composition matters.

demos.title: Interest Rate Risk
demos.summary: The Fed raises rates 100 bps. Your deposit costs jump, but loan rates locked in 6 months ago don't move. Asset-liability gap widens and net interest margin compresses. See how deposit mix, repricing speed, and customer behavior shape your funding cost under stress—and why banks hedge with derivatives.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "What's the biggest risk: losing deposits or deposit costs spiking?" This connects micro-level customer decisions (whether to leave for higher-yield accounts) to macro-level bank risk management.

demos.title: Liquidity Management
demos.summary: In a crisis, when will you run out of cash? Stress test deposits (what if 20% flee?), forecast outflows (payments, withdrawals), and calculate buffers you need. Monte Carlo shows the range of outcomes—and when to trigger contingency funding. Learn how risk officers set liquidity thresholds that prevent crises before they happen.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge assumptions: "What if 30% of deposits leave, not 20%? What if the Fed cuts rates faster than you expect?" This teaches how stress tests shape real-time treasury decisions.

demos.title: Credit Scoring
demos.summary: A customer's credit score drops 40 points. Should they be declined? More accurate models approve lower-risk borrowers but deny some good customers. Explore score drivers, pricing trade-offs, and Fair Lending constraints. Why transparent models win in banking—not just for compliance, but for customer trust and revenue.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on explainability: "Why does income matter more than payment history in this model? Can you defend that to regulators?" This teaches model governance and Fair Lending awareness.

demos.title: Fraud Playground
demos.summary: Block a fraudulent transaction and you save $500. Block a legitimate one and you lose a customer. Explore transaction patterns, anomaly scoring, and threshold trade-offs—the real dilemma fraud teams face every day. Learn why perfect accuracy is impossible (and expensive).
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why would you ever let a transaction through if the model says 'fraud'?" This reveals the operational cost of false positives and drives home the real trade-off: fraud prevention vs. customer experience.

demos.title: Blockchain Explorer
demos.summary: Why are central banks building CBDCs? How do stablecoins disrupt payments? Explore Bitcoin's settlement finality, Ethereum's smart contracts, and DeFi economics. Understand the tech your bank might build on—or compete against. Learn why decentralized finance works differently (and sometimes fails).
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Connect to bank strategy: "If DeFi protocols do settlement in 12 seconds and your bank takes 3 days, how do you respond?" This reveals why banks care about blockchain now, not just someday.

demos.title: AB Testing Framework
demos.summary: Your team claims a new feature increases engagement. But did it, or did randomness fool you? Design AB tests with proper controls, sample sizes, and significance thresholds. Learn why most "winning" features are false positives without rigorous experimental design.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "How many users do you need to see a real effect? What's the cost of a false positive vs. a false negative?" This reveals statistical rigor and business trade-offs.

demos.title: AI Content Summarizer
demos.summary: Review management-pack drafts with source evidence, unsupported-claim detection, and mandatory reviewer sign-off before finance narrative is released.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what would make the narrative unfit for CFO release even if the wording sounds plausible.

demos.title: AI Cost Benefit Analyzer
demos.summary: Your CFO asks: "Why invest $2M in AI when we don't know the payoff?" Build a business case by modeling infrastructure costs, labor savings, revenue uplift, and risk. See how hidden assumptions (adoption rates, productivity gains) drive ROI—and how small changes swing the decision.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge the assumptions: "What if adoption is 40% instead of 80%? What if labor savings never materialize?" This teaches sensitivity analysis and the power of assumptions in business decisions.

demos.title: AI Data Analyzer

demos.title: Collections Predictor
demos.summary: You have 200 invoices overdue. Who pays first? AI ranks by risk, but should you chase the $500K account that's 60 days late or the $50K account that's 120 days late? Learn how payment pattern history beats invoice size in predicting cash recovery.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why doesn't the biggest invoice always come first?" This reveals the power of behavioral signals—historical payment discipline trumps transaction size in risk assessment.

demos.title: Contagion Model
demos.summary: One bank fails. Does it crash the whole system? Model how losses propagate through interconnected institutions. See where your exposure lies and what breaks first. Learn why regulators fear systemic risk.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which institution, if it failed, would trigger the biggest cascade? Why?" This teaches systemic thinking.

demos.title: Copilot Kit
demos.summary: Your copilot is trained on company docs. Is it accurate or hallucinating? Explore prompt engineering, retrieval grounding, confidence scoring. Learn: "more training data" isn't always the answer—grounding and feedback loops are.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "How do you know when the copilot is making things up? What's your verification process?" This teaches grounding as a non-negotiable requirement.

demos.title: Counter Party Risk
demos.summary: Your bank lends to a seemingly healthy company. Their major customer just announced layoffs. How deep is your exposure? Monitor supply chain concentration and exposure triggers that predict defaults before ratings agencies do.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which one customer could bring them down? What's your exposure there?" This teaches forward-looking risk.

demos.title: Counterparty Risk
demos.summary: You have $500M exposure to a counterparty. Their credit rating just dropped. What do you do? Reduce exposure? Demand more collateral? Learn when concentration becomes unacceptable and how to monitor credit signals that predict defaults.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "At what exposure level would you demand action? Who decides?" This teaches risk governance.

demos.title: Credit Card Transaction Fraud
demos.summary: Local Python fraud-classification workflow for card transactions. Use it when you want students to move from a browser fraud intuition to a fuller feature-engineering and classification pipeline.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Which transaction features would travel well to real card auth data, and which are only classroom placeholders?"

demos.title: Credit Scoring
demos.summary: A customer's credit score drops 40 points. Should they be declined? More accurate models approve lower-risk borrowers but deny some good customers. Explore score drivers, pricing trade-offs, and Fair Lending constraints. Why transparent models win in banking—not just for compliance, but for customer trust and revenue.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on explainability: "Why does income matter more than payment history in this model? Can you defend that to regulators?" This teaches model governance and Fair Lending awareness.

demos.title: Data Drift Detector
demos.summary: Model trained 2022; still works 2025? Explore concept drift. Customer behavior changed, competition shifted. When do you retrain?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the reference distribution, current distribution, and drift signal.

demos.title: Dell vs Competitors Working Capital Case
demos.summary: Why does Dell unlock billions in cash faster than HP? Compare receivables, inventory, and payables cycles across the PC industry. See how Dell's direct-to-consumer model compressed CCC from 60 days to negative days—generating free cash while competitors waited. Understand business model impact on treasury.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Can Apple or HP replicate Dell's CCC?" The answer is no—because CCC isn't just a metric, it's a reflection of business model, customer mix, and operational excellence. Treasury is strategy.

demos.title: Digital Finance Portfolio Simulator
demos.summary: Sequence finance initiatives using value, readiness, dependencies, people resistance, control risk, and investment capacity instead of selecting projects one by one.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what should go in wave one even if it is not the flashiest initiative. Portfolio discipline beats demo glamour.

demos.title: Efficient Frontier
demos.summary: Diversification reduces risk. Build optimal portfolio—weights that minimize volatility for target return.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for asset return, volatility, correlation, and selected portfolio point.

demos.title: Embedded Firmware Exploit Wokwi
demos.summary: Flash reads customer data unencrypted. Reverse engineer to extract secrets. Understand firmware security.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for firmware behavior, input boundary, and failure mode.

demos.title: Emotional Support Assistant
demos.summary: Chatbot listens, responds with empathy. But can it recognize crisis? When must it escalate to human?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for user intent, sentiment cues, safety boundaries, and referral language.

demos.title: Experimentation & Metrics Simulator
demos.summary: Design experiments. Define success metrics. Run A/B tests. Learn p-values, sample size, statistical significance.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the experiment goal, primary metric, guardrail metric, and sample size.

demos.title: Feature Prioritization Copilot · PM Demo 02
demos.summary: 50 feature requests. Which matter most? Score by impact, effort, risk. Data-driven prioritization beats gut feel.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for value, effort, risk, and strategic alignment scores.

demos.title: Feature Store
demos.summary: 100 models, each needs features. Centralize them—governance, reproducibility, speed. Avoid reimplementing the same feature.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for feature definitions, ownership, freshness, and reuse across models.

demos.title: Finance Evidence and Data-Lineage Challenge
demos.summary: Trace generated commentary back to source rows and decide whether the output is fit for finance release or still contains unsupported statements.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: This is a great moment to contrast impressive output with defensible output. Finance only gets credit for the second one.

demos.title: Finance Signal Triage
demos.summary: Corroborate soft signals with finance metrics before escalation so sentiment, anecdote, and market noise do not masquerade as finance evidence.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which combinations truly deserve escalation and which should remain monitored but not yet amplified.

demos.title: Fraud Playground
demos.summary: Use this as the course’s fraud-threshold companion lab when discussing false positives, operational loss, and customer friction in payment monitoring.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask students which fraud threshold they would choose if support costs and abandonment are as important as raw fraud loss.

demos.title: FX Hedge Simulator
demos.summary: You sell ¥1 billion annually. USD strengthens and your revenue drops €2M. Did you hedge too little, or was the cost of hedging worse? Learn why CFOs are paid to make hedging decisions under uncertainty—perfect foresight doesn't exist in real markets.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Show both scenarios: "What if you'd fully hedged at a 2% premium? What if you'd hedged nothing?" This drives home that hedging trades downside insurance for opportunity cost.

demos.title: Graph RAG
demos.summary: Knowledge graphs organize facts as relationships. Find answers by traversing edges—better for reasoning over context.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for entities, relationships, graph context, and generated answer.

demos.title: Greeks Calculator
demos.summary: Volatility changes. Delta, gamma, vega tell you exposure. Learn Greeks without calculus.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for delta, gamma, theta, vega, and the option position being analyzed.

demos.title: Interest Rate Risk
demos.summary: About Demo learning guide for Interest Rate Risk: a browser launch surface with Colab and local notebook support for deposit repricing and shock analysis.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for deposit mix, rate shock, post-shock cost, and repricing concentration.

demos.title: Intrusion Detection
demos.summary: Network attack in progress. Spot the intrusion before damage spreads. Learn pattern detection, false positives, and alert tuning.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for network events, anomaly indicators, and alert classification.

demos.title: Invoice-Level Collections Prediction
demos.summary: Compare contractual due dates with likely payment behavior so collections, cash forecasting, and human review are grounded in evidence rather than aging alone.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask how much trust the CFO should place in the model output before it affects funding, collection actions, or external commitments.

demos.title: Io T Ethernet Pen Test v86
demos.summary: Firmware has buffer overflow. Exploit it. Understand why embedded devices are often insecure.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for network exposure, test vector, finding, and mitigation step.

demos.title: Liquidity Management
demos.summary: About Demo learning guide for Liquidity Management: a Colab and local notebook launch guide for liquidity stress testing and Monte Carlo analysis.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for inflow and outflow stress, liquidity gap, Monte Carlo range, and action threshold.

demos.title: Lite Parse Demo
demos.summary: Extract clauses from fictional contracts and invoices while keeping a visible boundary between information extraction and accounting judgement.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which clause can be extracted mechanically and which conclusion still needs finance or legal interpretation.

demos.title: Loan Default Predictor
demos.summary: You approve 90% of loan applications, but 8% default. Tighten lending and reduce defaults to 5%, but approval rate drops to 70%. Which trade-off is better for profitability? Learn how default prediction shapes portfolio composition, capital allocation, and bank risk-taking appetite.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge the threshold: "Why not deny everyone? You'd have zero defaults." This reveals the core lending paradox: higher accuracy ≠ higher profits. Portfolio composition matters.

demos.title: Local Chat Advisor
demos.summary: Chat runs locally, no data leaves device. Slower, smaller models. But privacy guaranteed. Trade-offs of local vs cloud AI.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the prompt, local response, and any limitations shown by the chat behavior.

demos.title: Malware Sandbox
demos.summary: Execute suspicious file safely. Watch network calls, registry edits, process spawns. Understand malware behavior.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for observed behavior, indicators, containment status, and risk rating.

demos.title: Mesa Liquidity Data Generator
demos.summary: Build a bank's balance sheet: customer deposits, savings rates, withdrawal patterns. Then stress it: what if 10%, 20%, 30% of customers withdraw simultaneously? Monte Carlo shows the range of liquidity outcomes. Learn how asset-liability managers size funding buffers and when to tap contingency facilities.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Emphasize the behavioral assumption: "You're assuming customers behave historically. But what if crisis sentiment changes behavior?" This connects data science to operational reality—models assume conditions stay stable when stress breaks that assumption.

demos.title: ML Model Registry
demos.summary: Track 100 model versions. Which is production? Which performed best? Who trained it and when?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for model version, dataset version, metrics, owner, and approval status.

demos.title: Model Version Comparator
demos.summary: V2 has 92% accuracy, V1 had 89%. But V2 is slower. Trade-offs matter—accuracy vs. latency vs. cost.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the baseline model, challenger model, metric comparison, and segment results.

demos.title: Monte Carlo Company Valuation
demos.summary: Interactive browser-based Monte Carlo simulation for company valuation, five-year free cash flow, NPV, probability of value creation, and statistical confidence intervals.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the acquisition price, five-year free-cash-flow path, terminal value, WACC, and NPV distribution.

demos.title: Monte Carlo Options
demos.summary: Stock could hit $150 or $50 in 3 months. What's option worth? Run simulations, not formulas.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for simulated paths, payoff calculation, and convergence behavior.

demos.title: Month-End Close Command Center
demos.summary: Decide whether close can proceed, which exceptions are material, what evidence is missing, and why the no-autonomous-posting rule matters in finance operations.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask whether the issue is speed, evidence, materiality, or ownership. CFO-facing close decisions usually combine all four.

demos.title: Mule Account Detection
demos.summary: Support the course’s AML and account-abuse discussions with a demo that connects suspicious flow patterns to intervention timing and false-positive burden.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask students whether faster intervention always helps, or whether it can also freeze legitimate customer activity and increase complaint load.

demos.title: Named Entity Tagger
demos.summary: Extract entities: names, dates, locations from text. See how context matters. "Apple" is company or fruit?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for named entities, categories, and context around each extraction.

demos.title: Network Traffic Analyzer
demos.summary: Packets flowing across your network. Identify protocols, anomalies, and data exfiltration. Analyze traffic for threats.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for traffic volume, protocol mix, source-destination patterns, and outliers.

demos.title: NPV Calculator
demos.summary: Project costs $10M upfront, saves $2M/year for 10 years at 8% discount rate. Is it worth it? Calculate NPV and IRR.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for cash-flow timing, discount rate, initial investment, and NPV result.

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Notebook
demos.summary: Use the Colab companion when you want students to inspect how variant counts, lead time, wait time, rework, first-pass yield, straight-through processing, and control exceptions are calculated from the event log. It uses the same fictional Asteron O2C data as the browser workbench and includes step-by-step explanations after each code block.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on the assumptions behind touch time and exception rules. The teaching value here is not the code itself; it is the transparency of the logic behind the finance conclusion.

demos.title: O2C Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Reveal how receivables actually flow through credit holds, disputes, short payments, and control exceptions before anyone decides that automation is the answer.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what should be eliminated upstream, what can be routed, and what still requires human judgement and monitoring.

demos.title: Opinion Quintuple Extractor
demos.summary: Extract sentiment, target, aspect, reason from reviews. "This phone's camera is great but battery drains fast."
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for opinion holder, target, sentiment, aspect, and explanation.

demos.title: Option Pricing
demos.summary: Black-Scholes options pricing calculator with Greeks. Learn derivatives pricing and risk management.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for intrinsic value, time value, volatility input, and option price.

demos.title: Options Pricing
demos.summary: Compare European vs American options, calls vs puts. Understand early exercise and optionality value.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for call and put values, strike, expiry, and volatility assumptions.

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Notebook
demos.summary: Use the Colab companion when you want students to inspect how variant counts, lead time, wait time, rework, first-pass yield, straight-through processing, and control exceptions are calculated from the AP event log. It uses the same fictional Asteron P2P data as the browser workbench and includes step-by-step explanations after each code block.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on the assumptions behind touch time and exception rules. The teaching value here is not the code itself; it is the transparency of the logic behind the finance conclusion.

demos.title: P2P Process Mining Workbench
demos.summary: Reveal how AP work actually flows through missing PO, missing GRN, duplicate review, approval delays, and control exceptions before workflow tooling is chosen.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which queue is a policy or discipline issue upstream and which part of the stable path is finally ready for workflow enablement.

demos.title: Page Index RAG
demos.summary: Index by page or section. Fast retrieval, but loses relationships between distant passages.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for page references, retrieved chunks, and answer grounding.

demos.title: Payment Journey and Rail Simulator
demos.summary: Choose UPI, cards, wallets, NEFT, RTGS, cash, or Bitcoin and watch the message flow, participants, clearing and settlement path, time to finality, fees, liquidity implications, and failure handling change in real time. This is the course’s anchor system-map demo.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "At which step does the customer think the payment is done, and at which step is the institution actually safe?" This separates experience from operational finality.

demos.title: Payment Operations and Reconciliation Workbench
demos.summary: Classify mismatches, fee differences, chargebacks, and unresolved exceptions using materiality, ageing, owner, SLA, and escalation outcome rather than just raw queue volume.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which exception is operational noise and which one is becoming a control or stakeholder issue.

demos.title: Pen Test Simulator
demos.summary: Web app has SQL injection vulnerability. Exploit it safely to prove risk before defenders patch it.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for authorized scope, test step, finding, and remediation priority.

demos.title: PII Detector
demos.summary: Scan documents for exposed personally identifiable information. See what an automated detector finds—and what it misses. Understand why human review is always required.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: What's the difference between true positives, false positives, and missed detections? When should you redact data without human review?

demos.title: PM Product Demos
demos.summary: Product management playbook: launch roadmap, feature prioritization, metrics. Build AI products, not just models.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the product decision, evidence, stakeholder, and recommended next step.

demos.title: Portfolio Optimizer
demos.summary: Stock A returns 8%, Stock B returns 12%. Which do you hold? Build efficient frontier—maximum return for each risk level.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for expected return, risk, correlation, and portfolio weights.

demos.title: Pricing and Unit Economics Explorer
demos.summary: Use this adjacent demo to reinforce fee design, platform economics, and business-model trade-offs when comparing payment products and merchant pricing.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what changes if the product owner optimizes growth, margin, and trust in a different order.

demos.title: Privacy Notebook
demos.summary: Analyze data privately. Differential privacy adds noise—protects individuals but costs accuracy. Find the sweet spot.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for sensitive data types, redaction behavior, and privacy risk signals.

demos.title: Probabilistic Decision Engine
demos.summary: Not binary decisions—probability scores. Approve if confidence > 75%. Learn confidence intervals, decision thresholds, ROI curves.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for probability estimates, decision thresholds, and expected value calculations.

demos.title: Public Policy Governance
demos.summary: Policy changes create compliance risk. Track regulation timelines, draft controls, test readiness.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for policy objective, stakeholder, risk, and control mechanism.

demos.title: QFD
demos.summary: Quality Function Deployment: translate customer needs to technical specs. Map requirements to outcomes. Design thinking for AI.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for customer need, importance, satisfaction, and quality-function linkage.

demos.title: Risk Parity Portfolio
demos.summary: Stocks rally; bonds fall. Balance portfolio so each asset contributes equal risk, not equal dollars. Why equal-weight 60/40 fails. See how risk contributions compound and why diversification requires rethinking weights.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why not just 60/40 stocks/bonds? What's the benefit of equal risk contribution?" This teaches portfolio thinking beyond traditional allocation.

demos.title: Secure Code Review
demos.summary: Code uses md5 for passwords. Hardcoded secrets in git. Review for vulns before deploy.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for code pattern, vulnerability class, evidence line, and secure fix.

demos.title: Semantic Search
demos.summary: Search by meaning, not keywords. "How do I fix my laptop?" finds articles about troubleshooting, not just "laptop."
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the query, retrieved documents, and relevance ranking.

demos.title: SIEM Dashboard
demos.summary: Millions of security logs daily. Which signals matter? Learn alert fatigue vs real threats.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for security events, severity, source, and response status.

demos.title: Smart Contract Treasury
demos.summary: Bring this in when the class moves from payment execution to conditional money movement, escrow logic, and programmable release conditions.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push students to compare smart-contract logic with ordinary API-based workflow controls rather than assuming the chain is always necessary.

demos.title: Smart Ticket Tagger
demos.summary: Customer support tickets flood in. Route by urgency, category, language. AI saves 40% manual triage time—but needs human oversight.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for the support ticket text, predicted category, and confidence level.

demos.title: Stablecoin Manager
demos.summary: You issue a stablecoin pegged at $1. Suddenly, $100M in redemptions arrive—everyone wants their USD back. You have enough reserves, but peg pressure forces a choice: raise interest rates to attract new deposits, or hold steady and watch the peg crack? Learn collateral management and reserve mechanics of decentralized stablecoins.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: This is modern monetary policy in real-time. Ask: "How is this different from managing a bank run?" Stablecoins are a treasury function for issuers—liability management under duress.

demos.title: Stack Smashing Visualizer
demos.summary: Firmware has buffer overflow. Watch stack overflow happen in real-time. Understand return address corruption, NOP sleds, and why stack canaries and ASLR matter.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Why is the return address a critical control flow target? What happens when it's overwritten?

demos.title: Standard RAG
demos.summary: Retrieve relevant documents, rerank, and generate answers. Baseline RAG—simple, but hallucinations happen.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for query, retrieved documents, generated answer, and citations.

demos.title: STRIDE Threat Modeler
demos.summary: About Demo learning guide for STRIDE Threat Modeler: a browser-based threat modeling tool with interactive DFD editor and auto-generated security threats.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Identify threat patterns from architecture decisions. Map threats to specific mitigations and security controls.

demos.title: Supply Chain Finance
demos.summary: Use this when discussing business-payment ecosystems, supplier settlement timing, and embedded-finance extensions around invoice and platform flows.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask where the payment ends and the financing product begins, and why that boundary matters operationally.

demos.title: SYNAPSE — Semantic Word Game
demos.summary: Game tests your knowledge of semantic relationships. Explore word embeddings—how AI understands meaning.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for word relationships, hints, and the path students use to reason semantically.

demos.title: Threat Hunter
demos.summary: Suspicious process spawned from Office macro. Hunt for lateral movement. Learn indicators of compromise.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for hypothesis, telemetry source, indicator, and evidence trail.

demos.title: Threat Modeling Matrix
demos.summary: Use this to surface security-by-design questions in payment apps, PSP integrations, beneficiary management, and mobile payment journeys.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask which payment-step threat deserves prevention first and which one deserves rapid detection plus recovery instead.

demos.title: Treasury Analytics Notebook Hub
demos.summary: Move from spreadsheets to analytics. Walk through a multi-week treasury forecasting workflow: data prep → anomaly detection → cash flow forecasting → dashboard insights. Learn how to catch forecast drift before it hits operations and how to automate weekly reporting that treasury teams can act on.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Push on this: "Your forecast was right 20 times but wrong 2 times catastrophically. Why trust it?" This reveals the gap between statistical accuracy and operational reliability—data quality matters more than model complexity.

demos.title: Treasury Control Tower
demos.summary: Frame the current treasury operating picture across liquidity, controls, alerts, and action choices so CFO-level decisions have an operating context before deeper analysis begins.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask what the top three actions are if the dashboard is directionally right but still incomplete. CFOs act under partial visibility all the time.

demos.title: Treasury Transform Blueprint
demos.summary: Your CFO says "we need to modernize treasury." Where do you start? Dashboard? Automation? API integration? Design a multi-year roadmap that prioritizes quick wins (free up cash now) while building toward future state (real-time insights, autonomous execution). Learn how transformation value compounds across initiatives.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Challenge sequencing: "Why would you build a dashboard before fixing data quality?" This reveals how treasury transformation requires sequencing—you can't automate garbage data.

demos.title: University Knowledge Assistant
demos.summary: RAG system answers questions about university policies. How do you ensure accuracy, not hallucination?
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for student query, knowledge source, retrieved answer, and citation.

demos.title: UPI Transaction and Failure Simulator
demos.summary: Simulate payer PSP, payee PSP, NPCI switch, remitter bank, and beneficiary bank across push and collect flows. Compare timeouts, duplicates, reversals, fraud checks, limits, and reconciliation exceptions without hiding the operational state machine.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Why is ‘pending’ often the most dangerous state in instant payments?" This reveals where customer, fraud, and reconciliation pain collide.

demos.title: VaR Calculator
demos.summary: How much can you lose in a bad market day? 1-in-100 scenario or 1-in-1000? Learn tail risk vs. average case. See why VaR is useful but incomplete—it measures risk but not the worst-case beyond it.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Ask: "Are you optimizing for expected loss or worst-case? What's your risk tolerance?" This teaches risk appetite definition.

demos.title: Voice Graph RAG
demos.summary: Speak your question, get answers from a knowledge graph. Better reasoning than keyword search.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for spoken query, graph retrieval, entities, relationships, and answer.

demos.title: Voice Notes App001
demos.summary: Record voice notes, search by speaking. NLP indexes and retrieves—useful for hands-free access to knowledge.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for spoken note, transcript, extracted action items, and summary.

demos.title: Voice Page Index RAG
demos.summary: Speak your question, search documents by page. Voice interface, standard retrieval strategy.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for voice query, page references, retrieved evidence, and generated response.

demos.title: Voice Standard RAG
demos.summary: Ask by voice, get answers from RAG pipeline. Understand limitations when retrieval fails.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for voice query, transcript, retrieved context, and generated answer.

demos.title: Vuln Scanner
demos.summary: Web server running outdated framework. Scanner finds CVEs—but which are critical? Know severity, exploitability, patch urgency.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for scan findings, severity, affected asset, and remediation suggestion.

demos.title: Whisper Transcriber
demos.summary: Convert speech to text. Works on accents, background noise. Understand accuracy, latency, computational cost.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for audio input, transcription output, and timing or speaker cues.

demos.title: Zero Trust
demos.summary: Assume breach. Verify every access, even inside the network. Learn zero trust architecture.
demos.teacherCue: Teacher cue: Look for identity, device, access request, policy decision, and trust signals.
